observations: Three photos show a large, light green industrial sewing machine wrapped in clear plastic.
The machine has a heavy-duty metal frame, a flat bed, a presser foot, and a visible needle and thread take-up lever.
Photo 0 shows the front-left side, with the needle and presser foot visible.
Photo 1 shows a side view, with the motor housing and part of the base visible.
Photo 2 shows the front-right side, with the control knobs and the feed dog area visible.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the machine in the photos.
The plastic wrap is crinkled and covers the entire machine, obscuring fine details and any labels.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area, with concrete floor and other items in the background.

claims.evidence: No brand name is visible in any photo; the seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
The machine is wrapped in plastic, so accessories, power cord, or other components cannot be seen. No proof of completeness is visible.

risks.risk: Machine is not a Phoenix brand or is a different model than claimed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand plate or nameplate on the machine, preferably from the front or side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown brand industrial sewing machine, which may be worth less than a Phoenix.

risks.risk: Machine is not functional or missing critical parts (e.g., motor, power cord, accessories)
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and running, or photos of all included parts laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or incomplete, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Machine has hidden damage or wear not visible under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos of the machine without plastic wrap, showing the condition of the metal, motor, and moving parts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or worn, which lowers value.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand nameplate or any label on the machine.
Photos of the machine without plastic wrap, showing all parts and condition.
Video of the machine running or photos of the power cord and accessories included.
response.reason: The brand and model cannot be confirmed from the photos, and the machine's completeness and condition are obscured by plastic wrap. Without proof of brand, functionality, and included parts, a reliable price cannot be determined.
